Presets and Continue editing, round four

T1 as you asked it, with three fills; the home ideas that had potential, pushed and crossed; and J1’s list drawn five ways, every operation in it. Captured from the app, dark, 80 × 24.

Your questions from round three

  • Why J1’s options differed: J1 reused edit mode’s own picker, which has only edit operations — Convert to, Quality and Compress live in other modes. Every J1 variant here lists them all.
  • Compressing a file already converted: it never happens. Continue editing reruns every step from the original in one encode — Compress means “aim that one JPEG at a size”, never a second pass over the JPEG, and since b91c125 it never goes above the Quality you chose. Round three’s J1, J2 and J4 showed the new JPEG on the card, which suggested otherwise; the variants here show the original.
  • J1 vs J4: the same screens; J1 is a list you come back to (every step and operation in view), J4 asked “another, save, done” after each step. J4’s result screen is J1’s list, so J4 folds into J1.

Questions for you

  1. Tabs (tab 1): which fill?
  2. Home (tab 2): which, now?
  3. Continue editing (tab 3): which way to draw J1’s list?

The three, pushed and crossed

N1The shelf, with its key

MY PICK. M3’s quiet pills under the field, led by p — M6’s key. p puts you in the shelf, ←→ moves along it, the lit one’s steps show under it, ↵ runs it on the staged file.

N2Only once a file is staged

Idle home stays exactly as today. Stage a file and the shelf appears with just the presets that can run on it (here two of three).

N3The seventh tab, keeping the drop zone

M1, but showing presets keeps the drop zone and the field as they are; the list sits under the field. The tab only appears once you have a preset.

N4p opens the menu at its presets

M6’s key, but no new window: p opens the / menu, where presets already live (round one), straight at its Presets section.

N5p presets in the field, beside ↵ enter

M6’s key moves into the field, as a quiet chip next to ↵ enter, so it sits right where the file is. p opens the presets that apply just above the field.
